Favorite.title: Favorite
Favorite.description: User's bookmarked scripture portions or holy characters.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this bookmark

type.description: Whether this is a bookmarked scripture or character

portion.description: Optional book portion or chapter reference

savedAt.description: Self-assigned server timestamp of the bookmark

Note.title: Note
Note.description: User's personal study notes for a scripture or character.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this note

itemKey.description: Key of the scripture or character the note is about

portion.description: Optional chapter, verse, or division coordinate

title.description: Custom user-provided or auto-generated note title

content.description: Note markdown content written by user or co-authored with AI

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Portion/verse-level threaded public notes or private discussions.

userId.description: The UID of the user who posted

isPrivate.description: Whether this comment is a private journal/note or public discussion

parentId.description: Optional parent comment ID for threaded replies

UserCustomImage.title: UserCustomImage
UserCustomImage.description: User's custom overridden image URL for a scripture book or a sacred character figure.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this custom image

itemKey.description: Key of the book or character (e.g. hindu_prayers or lord_krishna)

type.description: The type of content being overridden

imageUrl.description: The custom absolute image URL entered by the user

isLocked.description: Whether general users are locked out from setting or accessing certain interactive galleries

updatedBy.description: The administrator UID who modified this setting

AdminAuditLog.title: AdminAuditLog
AdminAuditLog.description: Log of administrative actions like changing gallery lock status or updating images.

action.description: The administrative action (e.g., TOGGLE_LOCK, UPDATE_IMAGE, RESET_IMAGE)

userEmail.description: Email of the administrator who performed the action

/favorites/{favId}.description: User bookmarks for character panels and scripture chapters.

/notes/{noteId}.description: Personal studiously recorded notes per character/scripture.

/comments/{commentId}.description: Portion/verse-level threaded discussions or private spiritual logs.

/system_settings/{settingId}.description: Global settings for locking galleries and other administrative policies.

/admin_audit_logs/{logId}.description: Audit logs of administrative settings changes and custom image management.
